changes: No substantive corrections; persons, date and ce_approx are correct.

date.as_written: saṃvat 1836 vikārīnāmasaṃvatsare dakṣiṇāyane āśvinamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe navamyā[ṃ] puṇyatithau maṃdavāsare

purpose: devotional dedication: śrīcintāmaṇiḥ prīyatāṃ; śrīvīreśvarārpaṇam astu
notes: The catalogue gives VS 1826, but the colophon reads saṃvat 1836. The year name Vikārin (vikārīnāmasaṃvatsara) fits 1779–80 CE, which equals VS 1836, so 1836 is right; VS 1826 would fall in Virodhin. Āśvina kṛṣṇa 9 falls around October 1779. 'Ci(!)tāmaṇiḥ' is read as Cintāmaṇi, a deity. Vīreśvara is a deity (the Śiva of Vārāṇasī), but no place of copying is stated. No human participants are named: no scribe, patron or owner.
